placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
We The Curious is a place to explore ideas by trying things out together. Let children lead the way through the interactive exhibits, making predictions and comparing what happens.

Our family idea: choose one question to investigate as a team, then give everyone a turn to pick the next activity. A planetarium show can add something special if a suitable session is available.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families who enjoy experimenting and asking why.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Interactive exhibits, cafe, toilets and spaces to eat a packed lunch.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Millennium Square car park is beneath the venue; check travel information before setting off.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Book ahead. Planetarium shows have separate booking and age requirements; 3D shows are not available to under-six children.
